lines.text: OAK: Oh! If it isn’t [VAR TRNAME(0000)]\nand [VAR TRNAME(0001)]!
You two are both looking a lot more grown up\nthan the last time I saw you.
And you have impeccable timing, as usual!\nLet me introduce you.
This is my grandson.\c\n...Erm, what was his name, now?
BLUE: Gramps, no one ever laughs at that joke!\nWould you give it a break?\c\nAnd besides, we’ve already met!
OAK: My own grandson...\nYou’re no fun...
BLUE: Yeah, yeah. Sure, Gramps.\nMore important than that, though...
[VAR TRNAME(0000)]! [VAR TRNAME(0001)]!\nYou two did awesome!
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Huh?
BLUE: With Team Rocket!\c\nI never thought that their boss would actually\nbe holed up there at Silph Co.!
And the two of you managed to take him down!
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: No, it wasn’t me!\n[VAR TRNAME(0000)] beat Giovanni all by h[VAR GENDBR(00FF,0202)]imerself!\c\nAll I did was help out a bit...
BLUE: So what? You and your Pokémon did your\nbest, too, right, [VAR TRNAME(0001)]?
So I’ve got a little something for you two!\nAs a reward for your hard work.
You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Key Stone[VAR COLOR(0000)] from Blue!

OAK: Oooh!
Isn’t that a Key Stone?\c
A stone that can trigger an Evolution that
transcends all other Evolutions—[VAR COLOR(0006)]Mega Evolution[VAR COLOR(0000)]!
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Mega Evolution?!\nWhat’s that?!

OAK: If you have both a Key Stone and the right
[VAR COLOR(0006)]Mega Stone[VAR COLOR(0000)]...\c
you can make a Pokémon [VAR COLOR(0006)]Mega Evolve [VAR COLOR(0000)]in battle!
Just one time per battle, though!

Your Pokémon will get all powered up to battle
hard for you!\c
Mega Evolution is proof of the [VAR COLOR(0006)]strong bond[VAR COLOR(0000)]
between a Pokémon and its Trainer!

Er-hem. A brief poem, if I may...\c
“When two stones are held...
When two hearts become as one...
We Mega Evolve...”
BLUE: The two of you should be able to use\nthese well! These are Mega Stones!

You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Venusaurite[VAR COLOR(0000)], a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Charizardite X[VAR COLOR(0000)],\na [VAR COLOR(0006)]Charizardite Y[VAR COLOR(0000)], and a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Blastoisinite[VAR COLOR(0000)]!
You’re gonna take on the Pokémon League,\naren’t you? Give these a try when you do!

BLUE: Oh. But what’re you even doing back here
in Pallet Town?\c
...What?
Viridian City’s Gym Leader is never at the Gym?\c
Huh, that’s odd...
Maybe I’ll go take a look myself...
OAK: You two are so close to\nthe Pokémon League now.\r\nJust one last push!
[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Mega Evolution...\nMan, if Team Rocket had used a thing like that,\r\nthey’d have been an even bigger pain!
I’ve heard there are many other kinds of\nMega Stones in the world, as well.
Mega Evolution is pretty rare here in Kanto!
Pallet Town may be small, but plenty of strong\nTrainers have come from here.\r\nI’d guess the professor must be pretty proud!
